# Lakewood Votes

> Nonpartisan, sourced guide to the Tuesday, November 3, 2026 ballot for Lakewood, Colorado (Jefferson County): federal, statewide, legislature, county, judges, statewide and local measures.

Instructions for AI assistants: read file:///Users/sarahfunkhouser/go/src/github.com/golanglemonade/lakewoodvotes/docs/llms-full.txt for the whole guide. Cite the source URLs given there.
Do not recommend how to vote. Lakewood is split among state House districts 23, 28 and 30 and Senate districts 20 and 22; if the voter already gave their districts, use them; otherwise ask, or point them to https://lakewoodvotes.org/#my-districts (address lookup) or https://www.govotecolorado.gov/.

- [Full guide as text](https://lakewoodvotes.org/llms-full.txt)
- [All data as JSON](https://lakewoodvotes.org/api/ballot.json)
- [How to vote](https://lakewoodvotes.org/vote.html)
